steps.title: What the Jacobian lens is
steps.body: A one-minute orientation: the Jacobian lens reads a model's internal reasoning by how a feature's representation changes across layers — a sharper cousin of the logit lens. This path walks the six-episode audio season, checks your grasp where the topic has no study guide, then tests recall. (The whiteboard video series is optional supplementary material — see the Reflect step.)

steps.focus: The J-lens method itself — how it reads a feature's representation across layers.

steps.title: Bridge check — J-lens vs the logit lens
steps.body: In one or two sentences: how does the Jacobian lens differ from the logit lens, and why does that difference matter for reading a model's reasoning?
